units..name: DuckDBSql
units.sql:
drop table if EXISTS my_ducklake.dws_test1;
create table my_ducklake.dws_test1 as SELECT c_name,c_custkey,o_orderkey,o_orderdate,o_totalprice,
    sum(l_quantity)
FROM
    my_ducklake.customer,
    my_ducklake.orders,
    my_ducklake.lineitem
WHERE
    o_orderkey IN (
        SELECT
            l_orderkey
        FROM my_ducklake.lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING sum(l_quantity) > 300) AND c_custkey = o_custkey
    AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
GROUP BY
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice
ORDER BY
    o_totalprice DESC,
    o_orderdate
LIMIT 100;
